fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the DCMS serve as the foundation of planetary defense, providing the manpower essential to territorial control while freeing BattleMech and armored assets for offensive operations. Motorized infantry travel on light unarmored vehicles that allow them to cover ground faster than the foot platoons that make up the bulk of DCMS garrison forces. District regulars rely on motorized platoons for security patrols across large garrison zones, forward observation, and the rapid response that foot troops cannot provide when trouble arises between widely separated posts. Support elements carry man-portable short-range missile launchers that fire the same warheads used by BattleMechs and combat vehicles. At close range, a well-aimed SRM can crack vehicle armor that personal weapons cannot scratch, giving the platoon a meaningful anti-armor capability.
